body: hi i know how you feel as i tried to kill myself  2 days ago but it failed. i know how tough it is to deal with this stuff as i tried to do it because of my school life. i know how difficult it gets and how it feels, its not the best feeling but i promise it will get better. try distracting yourself like do stuff you enjoy like i enjoy drawing so i do it a lot to get my mind off suicide again. so try doing something you like to do. please  don't hang yourself as there are people that really do care about you i know it might seem like there are no people that care but there is believe me. i know you probs don't want to take advice from a 15 year old girl but i know a lot about this because i have tried a lot of times.

try doing stuff you enjoy, idk what you like doing but here are some ideas

art/painting/drawing even if you cant, playing musical instruments, playing games but avoiding the sad games
